svg.aria-label: The PC player's picture passes on the game's own frame: the close button of the chart choice, two slanted strokes, from real runs on Windows at 1920x1080, enlarged pixel for pixel. Without anti-aliasing its edges are steps; SMAA and CMAA 2 smooth them over the finished picture; AMD FSR 1 enlarges the picture the game drew at 67 %, 1280x720, to the window's size and sharpens its edges
svg.text: Edges, as each picture setting draws them
The game's own close button at 1920x1080 on Windows, a run for each setting, enlarged pixel for pixel.
